baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative `أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌ` is followed by the parallel negatives `وَلَمْ ... وَلَمْ ...`.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question seeks a route for the boy's coming-to-be, then separately removes sexual contact and illicit sexual agency from the available ordinary routes.

activation_trace.role: The source-, manner-, and circumstance-question supplies the demand for a causal route.
Occurrence in time links the boy's future becoming to Mary's negated past state.
Sexual contact supplies the bodily route explicitly denied.
Sexual misconduct supplies the agentive and ethical route explicitly denied.

changed_reading.before: Mary simply expresses surprise that she could have a child.
changed_reading.after: Mary poses a structured causal problem: neither bodily mediation nor illicit agency can account for the promised boy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation `يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ` joins touch to a noun whose branch field foregrounds visible skin.
baseline_models.mechanism: The contact-root and human/skin-root converge on an embodied interface, specifying not generic solitude but the absence of skin-bearing human access capable of reproductive mediation.

activation_trace.role: Concrete tactile contact supplies the interface whose crossing is negated.
Visible skin supplies the bodily surface at that interface.
Skin-to-skin meeting sharpens the human noun into the absent reproductive encounter.

changed_reading.before: No man has had intercourse with Mary.
changed_reading.after: No embodied human interface has crossed into reproductive contact with Mary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same root appears in future `يَكُونُ` and negated past `أَكُ`.
baseline_models.mechanism: A future event is tested against a past identity: the verse makes who Mary has not been part of the causal evidence for what could become hers.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence binds the prospective boy and Mary's retrospective self-description into one frame.
The sexually transgressive identity is denied as a durable past state, not merely as one missing event.

changed_reading.before: The two negatives are redundant statements of chastity.
changed_reading.after: The verse opposes future becoming to both an absent event and a negated moral identity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ` makes an interrogative the content of Mary's saying.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question can activate the branch in which saying operates like supposition or judgment in an interrogative, so Mary externalizes an epistemic model rather than merely emitting surprise.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech makes the causal problem explicit and inspectable.
Saying that runs as supposition in a question supplies an epistemic, not merely emotive, force.
The open question of source and manner is the content of that stated epistemic position.

changed_reading.before: `She said` is only a dialogue tag before an exclamation.
changed_reading.after: Her utterance states the causal model that the subsequent discourse must revise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence supplies a protected boundary and a fully human appearance, so `no human touched me` cannot mean no human-seeming encounter; it isolates the un-crossed transition from appearance to bodily access.

activation_trace.role: Sexual contact is the precise transition the focus denies.
Prevention of access makes the veil an operative boundary.
A pictured or embodied representation supplies human form without supplying intercourse.
The visibly embodied human branch identifies what appeared on Mary's side of the boundary.
Refuge marks Mary's effort to prevent the apparent human from gaining access.

structural_cues: 19:16-18 orders withdrawal, veil, human-form appearance, and refuge before the focus denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a barrier, represented human form, and refuge; I infer appearance without access leads to the focus's narrower denial of reproductive contact. A live alternative is that these details explain only Mary's immediate fear.

changed_reading.before: Mary denies that any human encounter has occurred.
changed_reading.after: A human-seeming presence has occurred, but no passage from appearance across the protected boundary into reproductive contact has occurred.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding promise names the same boy as a gratuitous gift and as pure; Mary's two negatives then test whether a pure result can arrive without reciprocal sexual exchange or corrupt agency.

activation_trace.role: A gift without compensation supplies a non-exchange mode for the boy's arrival.
Purity and rectitude make the promised result ethically incompatible with an illicit route.
Sexual contact supplies the absent ordinary exchange.
Sexual misconduct supplies the corrupt route Mary excludes.

structural_cues: 19:19 places `غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا` immediately before the focus repeats `غُلَامٌ`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gratuitous giving and purity; I infer those qualities constrain the route as well as the result. A live alternative is that `زكي` characterizes only the child and does not comment on causation.

changed_reading.before: Mary cannot identify the father or biological process.
changed_reading.after: Mary asks how a pure, freely given boy can become hers when neither sexual exchange nor sexual wrongdoing can be its route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future `يكون` and past `أك` of the focus are answered first by a matter already cast as completed decree and later by `كن فيكون`; the event is future within Mary's experience but settled and speech-enacted at the level of decree.

activation_trace.role: Temporal occurrence supplies the focus's unresolved future and denied past.
Ease removes difficulty from the divine side of the causal asymmetry.
A manifest sign makes the unusual mode of becoming an intended public effect.
Past occurrence casts the still-future event for Mary as already established.
Perfecting and executing an act supplies the settled causal completion behind that past framing.
Uttered saying becomes the explicit medium of command rather than mere report.
The command-result pair `كن فيكون` turns occurrence itself into the answer to `أنى يكون`.

structural_cues: 19:21 answers the question with ease, sign, mercy, and a matter already decreed.
19:35 closes the causal account with `كن فيكون`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future/past forms, completed decree, and command-result speech; I infer a two-level temporality in which decree leads to experiential becoming. A live alternative is that the past form marks certainty rhetorically without positing distinct temporal levels.

changed_reading.before: Mary asks for a missing biological mechanism and receives a generic miracle claim.
changed_reading.after: Her future becoming is answered by an event already complete as decree and then instantiated through causative speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus excludes human sexual contact at origin, the sequence explicitly moves through inward pregnancy, labor, and birth; exceptional origination does not erase material embodiment but localizes the causal exception before gestation.

activation_trace.role: Denied sexual contact marks the exceptional point of origin.
Inward pregnancy or fruit supplies embodied development after that origin.
The pregnant body's disturbance in labor supplies a fully material transition to birth.
Actual giving birth completes the embodied sequence.

structural_cues: 19:22-23 moves directly from conception to withdrawal and labor; 19:27 shows Mary carrying the child; 19:33 names birth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pregnancy, labor, carrying, and birth after denied contact; I infer the exception is localized to origination, after which embodiment continues. A live alternative is that narrative compression prevents claims about how ordinary the elapsed process was.

changed_reading.before: No human touch implies a wholly disembodied production of the child.
changed_reading.after: Human sexual mediation is absent at origin, while pregnancy, labor, birth, and carrying remain emphatically embodied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The community later confronts Mary with an astonishing apparent offense and tests it through family character, repeating `بغي` of her mother; the focus's paired negatives therefore partition a future public defense into physical history and moral identity.

activation_trace.role: Absent sexual contact supplies the factual history component of the defense.
Denied sexual misconduct supplies the character component of the defense.
The assembled people supply the public forum in which the unexplained child must be judged.
The astonishing or monstrous act supplies the community's prima facie classification.
The repeated sexual-misconduct branch transfers the test to Mary's maternal pedigree.

structural_cues: 19:27-28 turns the private causal problem into public accusation and compares Mary with both parents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communal accusation, pedigree, and exact repetition of `بغي`; I infer the focus anticipates a forensic burden, with event history leading to one claim and moral identity to another. A live alternative is that the pair serves only Mary's private causal reasoning until the later scene retrospectively echoes it.

changed_reading.before: `No human touched me` and `I was not unchaste` repeat one chastity claim.
changed_reading.after: The clauses preserve two kinds of evidence that public judgment will require: what did not happen to Mary and who Mary has not been.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mary's spoken causal question is followed by abstention from human speech, a gesture toward the child, the child's speech, and a truth declaration; explanation migrates from the questioned woman to an alternate witness.

activation_trace.role: Mary's articulated saying establishes the question that requires an answer.
Restraint of the tongue removes Mary's own voice from the coming public defense.
Speech that connects interlocutors names the channel Mary explicitly suspends.
A bodily gesture redirects the demand for speech from Mary to the child.
The crowd's impossible speech question mirrors Mary's earlier impossible-birth question.
The child's articulated speech supplies the substitute testimony.
Truth matching reality frames that transferred testimony as verification rather than spectacle.

structural_cues: 19:26-30 orders vow, no human speech, gesture, crowd's `how`, and infant speech.
The crowd's `كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ` structurally echoes Mary's `أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ`.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies Mary's silence, pointing, a second impossibility question, and the child's answer; I infer her causal question leads to testimony being transferred away from her voice. A live alternative is that silence protects her socially without making the child a formal witness.

changed_reading.before: Mary states a claim that she will have to defend verbally.
changed_reading.after: Her focus utterance records the problem, but its public verification is deliberately made to leave her mouth and arrive through the child.

context_deltas.mechanism: `لِى غُلَامٌ` is clarified by the preceding gift and the later denial that God takes offspring: the child can be assigned to Mary in maternal relation without the giver acquiring a reciprocal lineage relation.

activation_trace.role: The young child supplies the relational object marked as `for me`.
Giving without return supplies entrustment to Mary rather than shared biological exchange.
Taking or acquiring supplies the filial relation explicitly denied of God.
Offspring by descent identifies the lineage relation excluded on the divine side.

structural_cues: 19:19 says the boy is given `to you`; 19:35 denies that God takes any offspring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a gift-to-Mary and a denial of divine acquisition of offspring; I infer asymmetrical relation, where source leads to maternity but not divine parentage. A live alternative is that `لي` is ordinary possession language without deliberate contrast to 19:35.

changed_reading.before: If God is the source of Mary's boy, source and parenthood blur together.
changed_reading.after: The boy is for Mary by gifted maternal relation, while divine causation is explicitly kept from becoming lineage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the actual token `أَنَّىٰ` is first an interrogative, while maturation is a branch-field resonance; it remains anchored in the focus's interrogative and youthful `غلام` and is activated by later emergence and ripeness. Downstream prose must present it as a timing/process echo, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `أَنَّىٰ ... غُلَامٌ` joins a root field containing arrival at due maturity to a noun of youth.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary source-and-manner question keeps the reading anchored in the actual interrogative.
Reaching due time or ripeness adds a process-and-maturation resonance to that question.
Youthfulness makes the endpoint of that maturation a young son.
A process that works toward what will emerge supplies an embodied answer to the maturation resonance.
Ripe dates add a nearby material image of reaching readiness after labor.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only where or how a boy can originate.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also asks how the promised son can reach his due embodied emergence, a process the later labor-and-ripeness sequence compresses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because `رَحْمَةً` in 19:21 means mercy, not womb; it remains valid as an explicit packet branch resonance anchored in a conception question and the denied sexual route. Downstream prose must call it a root-field material analogy and must not claim that the syntax substitutes womb for mercy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus asks for a boy without human sexual contact; the answer calls him `رَحْمَةً`.

activation_trace.role: Denied sexual contact leaves the reproductive route causally open.
Mercy is the explicit answer-category assigned to the child.
The womb branch supplies a contained material resonance beside that explicit mercy.

changed_reading.before: Mercy names only the benefit the child will bring after conception.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root-field echo, mercy hovers beside womb, allowing the answer to reroute the conception question through merciful embodiment rather than human touch.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain causal analogy, not a lexical equivalence: sexual touch is denied, while shaking a tree and gathering its fall occur later. It remains anchored in Mary's bodily agency and should be rendered as a contrast between stages, never as a claim that tree-shaking causes conception.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: `لَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ` excludes another human's reproductive contact but does not eliminate Mary's later bodily action.

activation_trace.role: Sexual contact marks the kind of bodily causation absent at origin.
Shaking until movement occurs restores Mary's own physical agency after conception.
Downward falling supplies the material result released by her action.
Taking produce from its source turns that action into acquired sustenance.

changed_reading.before: Absence of sexual touch makes Mary wholly passive within the event.
changed_reading.after: Agency is stage-specific: another human's reproductive touch is absent at origin, but Mary's own embodied effort later becomes a real means of care and sustenance.

strongest_changes: The prior human appearance sharpens the focus from denial of encounter to denial of boundary-crossing reproductive contact.
Future `يكون` becomes an experience-level unfolding of an act already completed in decree and enacted by `كن فيكون`.
Pregnancy, labor, birth, and carrying localize the exception to origin rather than dissolving embodiment.
The two negatives become distinct forensic claims, and public verification is transferred from Mary's speech to the child's.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates a double `كون`, parallel negatives, and overlapping contact, skin, sexuality, and speech fields; the surrounding sequence can therefore change its reading along temporal, embodied, social, and testimonial axes without abandoning its words.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the maturation branch of `ء ن ي` is a productive process resonance or only remote polysemy.
Whether the mercy/womb and later tree-action models remain useful once their analogical status is made explicit.
Whether the forensic force is already active in Mary's private question or becomes visible only retrospectively in 19:27-28.
